risk_tier: H0 independent review of attended D1 transient no-payload execution capability
review_scope: interaction with the reviewed H5 existing-published-source resident terminal, exact one-action attended D1, automatic handoff observation, native return, cleanup, health, recovery, and no-replay boundaries

reviewed_semantics.resident_terminal: The adapter first reopens the original H5 manifest through h5_existing.load_spec with freshness disabled only for historical D0 age, then requires the exact installed success journal and RESIDENT_HEALTHY terminal.
reviewed_semantics.canonical_journal: The original canonical ten-action no-stage journal is bound directly and revalidated during both manifest build and load; no synthetic journal or alternate parent is accepted.
reviewed_semantics.projection: Candidate, V2321 rollback, source, H5 version and build, target, recovery, observer, handoff, work path, and Phase3 rootfs profile are compared to the original reviewed terminal.
reviewed_semantics.one_action: The H5 branch independently requires max_actions exactly one during build and load. The existing durable intent, arm, reboot, cleanup, and no-replay machinery remains unchanged.
reviewed_semantics.device_effect: The changed adapter is host-only. The resulting live capability remains one attended D1 switch-root action with no payload transfer, partition write, flash, candidate transfer, or rollback transfer.
reviewed_semantics.other_lanes: Ordinary resident-install and preserved-cleanup-reduced evidence paths retain their previous execution semantics.

review_findings.finding: The first adapter revision inherited the generic one-to-thirty-two action range and did not itself enforce the selected one-ordinal H5 unit.
review_findings.resolution: Build and load now independently require H5 max_actions exactly one, with focused over-budget build and tampered-load rejection tests.

decision: PASS_GO for the exact H5 existing-source resident evidence adapter into one attended D1 action. This qualification grants no device authority.
review_lifetime: Reusable only while every named execution-critical hash, ten-action resident-terminal interpretation, exact H5 identity and source assumptions, one-action gate, handoff and recovery semantics remain unchanged and no new hazard or incident occurs.
